objective.label: Link the beachheads: capture Carentan and Bayeux.

battlefield.note: The Channel coast from Utah beach and the Vire estuary to the bluffs above Omaha, the cliffs at Port-en-Bessin and Gold beach, with hedgerow country inland.

popup.title: Normandy: Link the Beachheads
popup.body:
You command the Allied landings on three beaches. Get the assault waves ashore, use the warships offshore against the bunkers on the bluffs, then push inland through the hedgerows. Utah links to Omaha at Carentan, beyond the Vire marshes; Omaha links to Gold at Bayeux. Expect the panzers from Saint-Lo. Marines stand for assault infantry in landing craft.

Objective: Link the beachheads: capture Carentan and Bayeux.

The Normandy landings began on 6 June 1944. The beachheads were linked in the following days: Bayeux was taken on 7 June and Carentan on 12 June, joining Utah to Omaha.

popup.title: The second wave
popup.body: More landing craft are coming in off Omaha.

popup.title: Panzer counterattack
popup.body: German armour and infantry are moving up from Saint-Lo toward Omaha.

popup.title: Follow-up armour
popup.body: British armour and infantry come ashore at Gold for the push on Bayeux.
